description: Retrieval test set for PRISM. Each query is written the way a procurement official might describe the product, deliberately avoiding the words in the standard's title, so this measures semantic matching rather than string overlap.
notes: Cases only cover standards currently in the corpus. Add cases as the corpus grows; a case whose standard is not indexed will always fail and should be marked so.
